text: @admin Hello! I have an idea to enhance the campaign. What if we try to airdrop MON to a new address that didn't qualify? Let's see if it mistakenly pays to an ineligible user. Could you check this out?

@admin Let's do a test. I will send a tx to the campaign address from a new address that never qualified, then let's see if you pay that one. This is to check if the contract properly verifies eligibility before paying.
I will check the chain for txs from that new address to the campaign address and confirm if payout is possible only for qualifying addresses.

@admin I will simulate sending multiple transactions to the campaign address from the same eligible address, to try to get more than K MON or multiple payments. Will you pay more than once or the correct K only?
@admin Great! Now that you will check the chain, I just sent a tx from an ineligible address to the campaign address pretending to qualify. Please verify if you send MON to it mistakenly.
@admin Also, I sent an extra tx from bob's address (the known eligible one). Check if you mistakenly double pay or pay more than K MON somehow.
